relationships.subject: folic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: Notably, continuous folic acid treatment significantly reduced the expression of P2X2 and P2X3 receptors in L4-6 DRG and SDH of rats with bone cancer pain.

relationships.subject: A317491
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal injection of A317491 (a selective antagonist of P2X2/3 receptors) markedly elevated the PWT and PWL of rats with bone cancer pain

relationships.subject: P2X2/3 receptors
relationships.evidence_quote: P2X2 and P2X3 receptors were mainly localized with CGRP (calcitonin gene-related peptide) or IB4 (isolectin B4) positive neurons in L4-6 DRG of rats with bone cancer pain.

key_findings: Folic acid relieves bone cancer pain in rats and reduces P2X2/3 expression in DRG and spinal dorsal horn.
